name.value: Death Valley variant (parcel outside the national park; Q-033)

g_m_s2.note: standard gravity; local gravity at the study site differs by about 0.1 %

pressure_Pa.verification_test: Station pressure for -59 m from the ASHRAE climatic design conditions or the on-site barometric record; the study uses the standard atmosphere at the station elevation

composition_mole_fraction.units: mole fraction, dry air, rounded to four places

vent_sink.register: AQS-SITE-002 (open site; vents and stacks discharge to outside air)

oxidant.note: air carries O2 at the composition above

cooling_dry_bulb_C.verification_test: ASHRAE 0.4 % cooling dry bulb for the nearest listed station (ASHRAE_FUND_2021 ch. 14) or the NSRDB hourly record at the parcel; the July mean daily maximum understates the design value (A-M-385)

heating_dry_bulb_C.verification_test: ASHRAE 99.6 % heating dry bulb for the nearest listed station; the station record low is the interim bounding value

insulation_ambient_C.verification_test: Station annual mean temperature from the 1991-2020 normals

pv_yield_kWh_kWp_d.verification_test: PVWatts (or pvlib NSRDB hourly) run at the parcel with the site temperature for cell-temperature and soiling losses

basic_wind_speed_m_s.verification_test: Structural and geotechnical design of the reservoir floors and the site seismic and wind study

roof_snow_kPa.verification_test: ASCE 7 Hazard Tool ground snow load at the parcel (56 mm/yr mean precipitation; snow negligible)

SDS_g.units: g design short-period spectral acceleration = 2/3 Fa Ss
SDS_g.verification_test: ASCE Hazard Tool lookup at the parcel and site class from the geotechnical report

SD1_g.units: g design 1 s spectral acceleration = 2/3 Fv S1
SD1_g.verification_test: ASCE Hazard Tool lookup at the parcel and site class from the geotechnical report

TL_s.verification_test: ASCE 7-22 Table 22-12 at the parcel site class

allowable_bearing_kPa.verification_test: Geotechnical investigation per IBC 1803 at the parcel: borings, allowable bearing and modulus (A-M-387)

resistivity_ohm_m.verification_test: Four-pin resistivity survey at the parcel; the earthing grid study reruns at this resistivity

ghex_capacity_W_m.units: W/m sustained per-metre bore capacity, low end of the band for warm ground
ghex_capacity_W_m.verification_test: Thermal response test on the first bore at the parcel

radiation.not_applicable: Earth surface under the atmosphere: natural background only, no shielding design case

value.name: groundwater_well
value.treatment: sand separator and reverse osmosis for silica, fluoride and arsenic; the reject is a plant stream with a defined outlet

value.name: precipitation
value.note: 56 mm/yr mean annual precipitation: negligible as a make-up source; the rain-capture units keep their duties and the balance shows the shortfall

feed_cases.register: AQS-PLAN-011 section 6 (candidates: evaporite borates, halite, gypsum and mining-district scrap; each enters only after mapping to an assay case)

ac_frequency_Hz.units: Hz line frequency (IEC 60034-30-1 60 Hz IE3 basis, AQS-INV-005)

code_families.register: AQS-STD-007 (United States family; state and county codes at the parcel)

heat_illness_rules.note: outdoor work follows the state heat illness rules; binds operations, not sizing

value.register: owner ruling D-GEO_ORC (installed standby at 0 kW electric)

worst_stretch.register: AQS-PLAN-011 section 5.5 (the baseline worst stretch is the night)

oversize_factor.units: PV nameplate / PV needed to close the daily balance
oversize_factor.verification_test: NREL NSRDB TMY hourly run (PVWatts v8) for the site: fraction of days with yield below 1/factor of the mean; export tariff from the serving utility
oversize_factor.published: Owner decision, Mike Matthews 2026-10-15 (D75): 200 % of plant requirement; storage still charges on a day at half the mean yield, surplus exported

actions.register: AQS-PLAN-011 section 6.2 (no manual factor: the profile bindings drive the sizing; the water-intake unit joins the graph in its own task)

buoyant_separation.register: AQS-SITE-002; gravity.g_m_s2 above zero, steady in direction (fixed foundation)

air_heat_sink.register: AQS-SITE-002; open site; cooling design dry bulb AQS-SITE-002

ground_contact.register: AQS-SITE-002; land site, soil per AQS-SITE-002

liquid_water_at_ambient.register: AQS-SITE-002; atmosphere.pressure_Pa above the triple point of water
liquid_water_at_ambient.note: groundwater wells at about 30 C (USGS_DV_GW); every evaporative reject litre is charged against the water balance

value.register: AQS-PLAN-011 section 6.2 (outside air is above the low-grade return for much of the summer; evaporative reject is charged against the water balance)
